mapper.sql: ID , USERNAME , PLACE_TYPE , LABEL , ZONECODE , ADDRESS , ADDRESS_DETAIL , LATITUDE , LONGITUDE , REGION_ID , DATE_FORMAT(CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS CREATED_AT , DATE_FORMAT(UPDATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS UPDATED_AT
mapper.select: SELECT FROM USER_PLACES WHERE USERNAME = #{username} ORDER BY FIELD(PLACE_TYPE, 'HOME', 'WORK', 'FAV'), LABEL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_PLACES ( USERNAME, PLACE_TYPE, LABEL, ZONECODE, ADDRESS, ADDRESS_DETAIL, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, REGION_ID ) VALUES ( #{username}, #{placeType}, #{label}, #{zonecode}, #{address}, #{addressDetail}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{regionId} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE ZONECODE = VALUES(ZONECODE), ADDRESS = VALUES(ADDRESS), ADDRESS_DETAIL = VALUES(ADDRESS_DETAIL), LATITUDE = VALUES(LATITUDE), LONGITUDE = VALUES(LONGITUDE), REGION_ID = VALUES(REGION_ID)
